description: One TED notice by its publication number, normalized: notice and form type, lifecycle stage, title and description, buyer with identifiers, CPV codes, procedure type, place of performance, estimated values (procedure and lots, with currency), lot titles and submission deadlines, duration, submission URL, and for results the winners, winner size and country, tender and award values and contract dates as published. With official HTML, PDF and XML links and the changes YRUZ observed since an earlier look. Price: 0.004 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_notice"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/notice?id=645054-2026
name: tenders_get_notice
